blocks.en_text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 大家好，欢迎来到Real Easy English。

blocks.en_text: In this podcast,
blocks.zh_text: 在这期播客里，

blocks.en_text: we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
blocks.zh_text: 我们用简单的英语进行真实的对话，帮助大家学习。

blocks.en_text: I'm Neil.
blocks.zh_text: 我是Neil。

blocks.en_text: And I'm Beth.
blocks.zh_text: 我是Beth。

blocks.en_text: You can find a video version of this podcast
blocks.zh_text: 你可以在我们的网站上找到这期播客的视频版

blocks.en_text: and a free worksheet to help you learn on our website,
blocks.zh_text: 和一份免费的学习练习表，

blocks.en_text: bbclearningenglish.com
blocks.zh_text: 网址是bbclearningenglish.com

blocks.en_text: Hi Beth, how are you?
blocks.zh_text: 嗨，Beth，你好吗？

blocks.en_text: I'm good, Neil. How are you?
blocks.zh_text: 我很好，Neil。你呢？

blocks.en_text: Very well, thank you.
blocks.zh_text: 非常好，谢谢。

blocks.en_text: What are we talking about today?
blocks.zh_text: 我们今天聊什么？

blocks.en_text: Today we are talking about housemates.
blocks.zh_text: 今天我们聊室友。

blocks.en_text: Housemates – the people that you share a house with who aren't your family.
blocks.zh_text: 室友——就是和你合住一个房子、但不是你家人的人。

blocks.en_text: Maybe they're your friends,
blocks.zh_text: 他们可能是你的朋友，

blocks.en_text: or even strangers who just need somewhere to live.
blocks.zh_text: 也可能只是需要找个地方住的陌生人。

blocks.en_text: Exactly. And it's quite common in the UK to live with housemates
blocks.zh_text: 没错。在英国，和室友一起住很常见，

blocks.en_text: when you're younger.
blocks.zh_text: 尤其是在你年轻的时候。

blocks.en_text: Have you ever lived with housemates?
blocks.zh_text: 你以前和室友一起住过吗？

blocks.en_text: Yes, of course. I had house or flatmates when I was a student
blocks.zh_text: 当然住过。我当学生的时候有过室友或合租伙伴，

blocks.en_text: and then after I was a student in my first jobs and before I got married.
blocks.zh_text: 后来毕业了、做第一几份工作的时候，还有结婚之前，也都和人合住过。

blocks.en_text: That's exactly the same as me.
blocks.zh_text: 我跟你完全一样。

blocks.en_text: So, when I went to university, I moved in with five people,
blocks.zh_text: 我上大学的时候，和五个人一起住，

blocks.en_text: and we all had a separate room and a separate bathroom.
blocks.zh_text: 我们每人都有独立的房间和独立的卫生间。

blocks.en_text: But yeah, they were my flatmates for my first year of university.
blocks.zh_text: 不过，大学第一年他们算是我的合租室友。

blocks.en_text: But in my second year, then I moved into a house and we all shared a bathroom,
blocks.zh_text: 到了第二年，我搬进了一栋房子，我们共用一个卫生间，

blocks.en_text: and they were my housemates because we were in a house.
blocks.zh_text: 他们就是我的室友了，因为我们住在一栋房子里。

blocks.en_text: Did you enjoy having housemates?
blocks.zh_text: 你喜欢有室友吗？

blocks.en_text: I think it really depends on the people that you live with.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得这真的取决于跟你一起住的人。

blocks.en_text: I have had some bad housemates.
blocks.zh_text: 我遇到过一些糟糕的室友。

blocks.en_text: Bad because they weren't tidy, didn't clean.
blocks.zh_text: 糟糕是因为他们不爱整洁，不打扫卫生。

blocks.en_text: There were dishes in the kitchen that were dirty
blocks.zh_text: 厨房里有脏盘子，

blocks.en_text: and not cleaned for a long time.
blocks.zh_text: 很久都没洗。

blocks.en_text: But I've also had some really nice housemates as well.
blocks.zh_text: 但我也遇到过一些非常好的室友。

blocks.en_text: Do you enjoy living with housemates or did you enjoy living with housemates?
blocks.zh_text: 你喜欢和室友一起住吗，或者说你以前喜欢和室友一起住吗？

blocks.en_text: I think as you said, it really depends on the person.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得就像你说的，这真的取决于人。

blocks.en_text: So, you mentioned people being messy and that kind of thing.
blocks.zh_text: 你刚才提到有人很邋遢之类的。

blocks.en_text: Also, noisy people are difficult.
blocks.zh_text: 还有，吵闹的人也很难相处。

blocks.en_text: But some of my best friends now have been my housemates in the past.
blocks.zh_text: 但我现在一些最好的朋友，就是以前的室友。

blocks.en_text: So, I think you can really get to know people very well.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我觉得，你真的可以很深入地了解一个人。

blocks.en_text: And you can also meet some people
blocks.zh_text: 你也可能遇到一些人，

blocks.en_text: who you never want to see again in your life!
blocks.zh_text: 你这辈子再也不想见到他们！

blocks.en_text: That's true!
blocks.zh_text: 确实如此！

blocks.en_text: So, Neil, what do you think is the best kind of personality,
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Neil，你觉得什么样的性格最好，

blocks.en_text: the best kind of person to live with?
blocks.zh_text: 最适合一起住的是什么样的人？

blocks.en_text: They have to be easygoing.
blocks.zh_text: 他们得随和才行。

blocks.en_text: What does that mean?
blocks.zh_text: 那是什么意思？

blocks.en_text: Somebody who is easygoing is relaxed,
blocks.zh_text: 随和的人就是很放松，

blocks.en_text: and they don't get too upset or angry over little things.
blocks.zh_text: 不会因为小事就太难过或者生气。

blocks.en_text: And they're quite easy to live with.
blocks.zh_text: 而且跟他们住在一起挺轻松的。

blocks.en_text: And there's the clue – easygoing.
blocks.zh_text: 这里就有线索了——随和。

blocks.en_text: I think something else important about living with other people
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得跟别人一起住还有一点也很重要，

blocks.en_text: or renting somewhere,
blocks.zh_text: 或者是租房住，

blocks.en_text: so paying monthly, is having a good landlord.
blocks.zh_text: 也就是按月付钱，那就是得有个好房东。

blocks.en_text: It's very important.
blocks.zh_text: 这非常重要。

blocks.en_text: So, who is a landlord?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，谁是房东？

blocks.en_text: What is a landlord?
blocks.zh_text: 什么是房东？

blocks.en_text: So, the landlord is, or landlady is, the person that owns the house or flat
blocks.zh_text: 房东就是拥有这套房子或公寓的人，

blocks.en_text: that you're in and you pay them rent.
blocks.zh_text: 你住在里面，然后付给他房租。

blocks.en_text: So, you pay them a monthly amount.
blocks.zh_text: 也就是你每个月付给他一笔钱。

blocks.en_text: But you might live there for a year or two years or three years,
blocks.zh_text: 你可能在那儿住一年、两年或者三年，

blocks.en_text: but you don't own the place.
blocks.zh_text: 但你不拥有这个地方。

blocks.en_text: It's the landlord that owns the place.
blocks.zh_text: 是房东拥有这个地方。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, and a good landlord can make a big difference.
blocks.zh_text: 对，一个好房东能带来很大的不同。

blocks.en_text: Neil, are you easy to live with?
blocks.zh_text: Neil，你是个好相处的人吗？

blocks.en_text: Should we be flatmates?
blocks.zh_text: 我们要不要做室友？

blocks.en_text: I don't know, but I think I have made some good friends
blocks.zh_text: 我不知道，不过我觉得我交到了一些好朋友，

blocks.en_text: when I've been a housemate.
blocks.zh_text: 在我做室友的时候。

blocks.en_text: So, they think that I was a good housemate.
blocks.zh_text: 所以，他们觉得我是个不错的室友。

blocks.en_text: OK.
blocks.zh_text: 好。

blocks.en_text: How about you?
blocks.zh_text: 你呢？

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I think I'm easy to live with,
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，我觉得我挺好相处的，

blocks.en_text: but I like to sing a lot, so maybe people would tell me to be quiet.
blocks.zh_text: 但我很喜欢唱歌，所以也许别人会让我安静点。

blocks.en_text: Although no one's ever told me to be quiet...
blocks.zh_text: 不过从来没人让我安静过……

blocks.en_text: but maybe they wanted me to and just didn't say!
blocks.zh_text: 但也许他们想让我安静，只是没说出口！

blocks.en_text: Let's recap the vocabulary we've heard in this podcast,
blocks.zh_text: 我们来回顾一下这期播客里听到的词汇，

blocks.en_text: starting with 'housemate'. A housemate is someone you live with
blocks.zh_text: 从“housemate”开始。室友就是跟你一起住的人，

blocks.en_text: who probably isn't part of your family.
blocks.zh_text: 他可能不是你的家人。

blocks.en_text: We also hear 'flatmate'.
blocks.zh_text: 我们还听到了“flatmate”。

blocks.en_text: And we had 'easygoing', which means relaxed and not easily upset.
blocks.zh_text: 还有“easygoing”，意思是放松、不容易生气。

blocks.en_text: Flatmates or housemates often 'rent' a property
blocks.zh_text: 室友或同住的人通常会“租”一处房子，

blocks.en_text: and that means they don't own it –
blocks.zh_text: 意思是他们不拥有它——

blocks.en_text: they pay money to the person who does own it.
blocks.zh_text: 他们把钱付给真正拥有它的人。

blocks.en_text: And the person who owns the house or flat is the 'landlord'.
blocks.zh_text: 而拥有这套房子或公寓的人就是“房东”。

blocks.en_text: That's who you pay every month and they own the property.
blocks.zh_text: 你每个月付钱给他，房子是他的。

blocks.en_text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English. To test what you've learnt,
blocks.zh_text: 这期Real Easy English就到这里。想测试你学到的东西，

blocks.en_text: there's a worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com
blocks.zh_text: 我们网站上有练习题，bbclearningenglish.com

blocks.en_text: And we'll be back next week with another easy English conversation.
blocks.zh_text: 下周我们会带来另一段轻松的英语对话。

blocks.en_text: Bye for now.
blocks.zh_text: 先再见啦。

blocks.en_text: Goodbye!
blocks.zh_text: 再见！
